newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran's Rafsanjani leaves on Turkey visit.
newsitem.headline: Iran's Rafsanjani leaves on Turkey visit.

text.p: Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani left for Turkey on Thursday for talks on strengthening ties, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said.

IRNA quoted Rafsanjani as saying before leaving Tehran that he would discuss "different issues including bilateral and regional cooperation, the latest developments in the Persian Gulf and in Iraqi Kurdistan as well as promotion of relations" during the four-day visit at the invitation of President Suleyman Demirel.
"Various economic agreements will be inked by the two sides during the visit," he said.
Turkey's first Islamist prime minister, Necmettin Erbakan, visited Iran in August and signed a $23 billion agreement for the supply of Iranian natural gas over 23 years.
Iran, like much of the Moslem world, was angered earlier this year when Turkey signed a deal with Israel, allowing Israeli air force planes to train in Turkish airspace.
